تصاءيت (form VI)
# تَصَاءَيْتُ (taṣāʔaytu) /ta.sˤaː.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَاءَى (taṣāʔā)
# تَصَاءَيْتَ (taṣāʔayta) /ta.sˤaː.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَاءَى (taṣāʔā)
# تَصَاءَيْتِ (taṣāʔayti) /ta.sˤaː.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَاءَى (taṣāʔā)
